race.comment: BARGAIN BOY (2) might find this a little sharp of his best but might be too classy fresh. Lightly raced galloper with best figures over a bit further but has won here and did win only other try this trip. Fitter for two trials and with a strong pace up front will be steaming home late. EXPECTO PATRONUM (3) is a progressive type who was an easy maiden winner at second outing, leading throughout to score at the provincials. Has upside and will take running down again. IRONBAR (4) stormed home last time in tougher grade here and finished in the minors. Up in weight but aided by the claim and will be tough to stop again. ZESTIMAN (5) missed the frame last start when he settled well back and wide off an outside draw over 1250m at this track. Better gate this time and can improve sharply. GUSTY WAY (1) wasn't beaten far last time and will give a sight this longer journey.
